study: West, Morton & Herlihy 2016 (Achievement Network / ANet i3, CEPR Harvard)
delivery_evidence: ANet PD delivered primarily in person: on-site coach visits ('Coach visits are an integral component') and in-school data meetings bringing together Grade 3-8 ELA/math teachers for group PD in three-hour after-school blocks; the online MyANet platform is a teacher-facing data-reporting tool, not the mode of PD delivery (Sec. 'The ANet Program', pp.5-7).
test_alignment_evidence: Both full-sample included outcomes are summative state ELA and math tests (state administrative records), broad independent/distal assessments not tailored to ANet; extraction test_type = standardized_independent (Tables 5.1/5.2, ES.2).
curriculum_evidence: ANet is data-driven-instruction PD (interim assessments + online data platform + coaching on using data) aimed at improving teachers' use of assessment data within their existing instruction; no new curriculum/textbook/instructional-materials package is adopted (Sec. 'The ANet Program', pp.5-7).
outcome_timing_evidence: Included full-sample effects measured on the Year-2 state test (end of two years of treatment), same school year as the final treatment year; no post-treatment follow-up wave (extraction timepoint 'post (end of Year 2 / two years of treatment)', Table ES.2).
